$description: Machine-readable index of every file in assets/. Keep it complete: scripts/validate.py fails if a file is missing here or an entry points nowhere. kind: logo|symbol|label|lockup|icon|ui-glyph|illustration|infographic|photo|font|license. ui-glyph = small functional UI marks (arrows, chevron, check, plus/minus, close, menu, quote, social) from the live site's icon set, distinct from the brand pictogram icons. use_on: backgrounds the asset is approved for; ["any"] for self-contained artwork and photos, [] for files that are not placed on a background (fonts, licences). rights: usage note where rights or consent need checking.
